imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The T-shirt guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 108 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 39.45. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings. No non-branded page or query showed a repeatable combination of volume and positions 4–20.
searchConsole.decision: No new page is labeled Data-led because the sample cannot support one. The report instead informed discovery work: three unrelated intents are placed on the homepage, three department hubs and the Library, supported by twelve reciprocal contextual links, a regenerated sitemap and the publication manifest.
searchConsole.ignored: Two impressions for the jet-lag query at average position 8, two impressions for the contractor-estimate page at 8.5, one charity-page impression at 11 and six homepage impressions at 5.5 were deliberately ignored as too small, mixed or non-specific for a topic pivot or title rewrite.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the T-shirt guide. The moisturizer and net-worth field manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready personal net-worth statement and annual review worksheet that fixes the owner, scope, valuation date, evidence, valuation method, liquidity and uncertainty for each line while separating the balance sheet from cash flow and broader financial well-being.
authority.cluster: Personal-finance operating authority, with reciprocal paths from established bill-account, beneficiary, retirement-rollover and household-record guides; the T-shirt and moisturizer pages expand separate garment-fit and evidence-led grooming clusters.
authority.opportunity: Logged two qualified, primary-source-aligned review opportunities for the net-worth worksheet. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Style, Grooming and Life: how to choose an outerwear T-shirt by fit and fabric facts; how to select and trial a face moisturizer; and how to build a dated, auditable personal net-worth statement. The T-shirt guide serves high purchase intent, the moisturizer guide expands evidence-led grooming authority, and the net-worth worksheet explores a practical annual money system. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
